mechanism: Cenobamate is a CYP3A4 inducer that may increase vedolizumab metabolism, potentially reducing its therapeutic efficacy; vedolizumab is an immunosuppressant that may increase seizure risk if cenobamate levels are subtherapeutic.
action: Monitor vedolizumab efficacy closely and consider therapeutic drug monitoring of cenobamate; assess for breakthrough inflammatory bowel disease symptoms or seizure activity; discuss with neurology and gastroenterology for coordinated dosing.
